question.en: Discuss the role of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in ensuring global food security.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in ensuring global food security.

modelAnswer.en: The FAO plays a critical role by providing policy advice, technical assistance, and data collection to combat hunger. It facilitates international cooperation, sets standards for food safety, and promotes sustainable agricultural practices to ensure long-term food security.
